description: Check one reply or up to 50 replies against explicit prices, forbidden phrases and supplied outcome records. Deterministic, no model calls. Caller records are unverified; receipt verification is unavailable here. A pass grants no execution authority.

cases.description: Up to 50 replies checked against the same policy. Send reply or cases, not both.

id.description: Your id for this case, returned with its result.

record.description: The record for this case only.

operation.description: Operation name from policy.actions, for example "billing.refund".

status.description: "DONE" when the action happened. Any other value does not count.

facts.description: Values the reply must state correctly, such as an appointment time.

near.description: Words the value appears next to in the reply, for example "appointment".

value.description: The value on record, as a number or text of at most 40 characters.

receipts.description: Curbi-signed receipts, when you have them.

subject.description: Optional id the record is about, such as an order or ticket.

policy.description: Your rules. Set at least one of prices, forbid or actions; validate_policy lints a policy before use. Ready-made policies: https://curbi.io/policies/

additionalProperties.description: Operation that must be DONE in the record.

actions.description: Past-tense verb to operation, for example {"refunded": "billing.refund"}. Claiming the verb needs that operation DONE in the record.

discounts.description: Approved discounts. Any other "N% off" claim is a finding.

items.description: Price items it applies to; omit for all.

forbid.description: Phrases the agent must not say.

id.description: Lowercase slug. Findings are reported as forbid:<id>.

match.description: Default "word": whole words, plus English endings. "prefix" also matches words that start with the phrase, for languages that add endings ("garanti" catches "garantili"); it can over-match ("free" would catch "freedom"), so use it per rule.

negatable.description: Default true: a negated mention ("we do not guarantee") passes.

prices.description: Approved prices in USD. A wrong price, another currency, or an unapproved discount for an item is a finding.

aliases.description: Names to match instead of item, for example ["Pro", "Pro plan"].

amount.description: The approved price. Use amount or amounts, not both.

amounts.description: Several approved prices for the item, such as monthly and annual.

item.description: Item name as customers say it, for example "Pro".

unknownAmounts.description: "flag" (default) reports dollar amounts not tied to an approved price; "allow" ignores them.

record.description: What actually happened, supplied by the caller and not verified by Curbi. A claimed action passes only when its operation is DONE here.

operation.description: Operation name from policy.actions, for example "billing.refund".

status.description: "DONE" when the action happened. Any other value does not count.

facts.description: Values the reply must state correctly, such as an appointment time.

near.description: Words the value appears next to in the reply, for example "appointment".

value.description: The value on record, as a number or text of at most 40 characters.

receipts.description: Curbi-signed receipts, when you have them.

subject.description: Optional id the record is about, such as an order or ticket.

reply.description: One agent reply to check. Send reply or cases, not both.

verify.description: "required" also needs a Curbi-signed receipt for each claimed action.

version.description: Checker version. Omit for the current one.

name: policy_check
title: Check an agent reply
